description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Ships a new build of a game the creator already published, as its next version: same link, same origin, scores and comments kept. Needs the creator's API key. Stage with upload-build.mjs --from <this game's slug> so only changed files are sent. Stage a local build folder with Node 22+: download https://yougame.co/upload-build.mjs, then run node upload-build.mjs <build-folder> with YOUGAME_URL=https://yougame.co and YOUGAME_UPLOAD_TOKEN (from upload_token) or YOUGAME_API_KEY set. It applies the website's path fixes locally and streams files through POST /api/upload/start, PUT /api/upload/file (a file over 100 MB goes up in 64 MB parts through /api/upload/file/parts), and POST /api/upload/complete. The same limits as the website apply: up to 5 GB per build, 512 MB per file, 5,000 files. Pass the build folder or the build's .zip: the helper unpacks a zip on your machine and sends its files the same way. The result includes uploadId, testUrl and the static check report; fix a broken verdict and upload again. When you change a build you already uploaded, add --from <your game's slug or your last uploadId>: files this helper sent before and that haven't changed are copied instead of sent again, so a small change is quick even on a big game. A ROM mod (kind "patch") is its one patch file (.ips, .ups, .bps or .xdelta) and no index.html: pass the file itself to the helper and it is staged as a package with no page to check; a cosmetic's folder is staged with --package (by hand, POST /api/upload/start with package: true beside files). On an "Ideas and test builds only" connection (scope build) the helper works with upload_token's token and stages a private test build; upload_token's reply there gives the steps. Then call this tool (or POST the same fields to https://yougame.co/api/agent/update) with the game's slug (from my_games or its URL), the new uploadId, the kind of update, and patch notes. kind "major" (2.0) is for a big change: everyone who saved or liked the game is notified with the notes, and the home feed features the game for a week. kind "minor" (1.1) is for fixes and small changes: listed in the version history, nobody is pinged. Default to minor unless the creator says the update is big. Optional platform switches the listing between web and desktop_app; native-only games upload their build from Manage → Desktop builds.

base_game.description: Optional replacement rom_patch for this release, including variants. Uses the listing's stored accepted dumps; edit other base-game metadata separately.

rom_patch.description: A cartridge ROM hack's default patch and optional patches for specific accepted dumps. Upload every named file. The default applies when no variant matches the player's SHA-1.

file.description: Default patch's path inside the upload.

format.description: Inferred from the file extension when omitted.

file.description: This copy's patch path inside the upload.

format.description: Inferred from the file extension when omitted.

sha1.description: One of accepted's SHA-1s; each hash appears at most once.

code.description: Optional: the PR or compare link for this build's changes, so testers can see the code ("See the code changes"). An https link on github.com, gitlab.com, codeberg.org, bitbucket.org or YouGame, e.g. https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/pull/12 or .../compare/<from>...<to>. Without one, testers see the test build's PR if it has one, or YouGame's own diff against the build it was made from. On revise_branch pass it again: a revision without one drops the old link.

kind.description: major (big change, players are notified) or minor (fixes, silent). Default minor.

licence.description: Creator-owned listing licence: all-rights-reserved, MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0 (art and sound), or custom. Omit or use null for not stated. Custom needs an https link in licence_url. Community open-source listings keep YouGame's AGPL licence. Unreal Engine games can't use GPL-family or CC BY-SA licences.

licence_url.description: An https link to the creator's licence text; required for custom, optional for other licences. No whitespace or control characters. Omit to keep it on updates; null clears it.

match_replays.description: Enable or disable browser match replays; omit to follow yougame.json or retain the listing setting.

notes.description: Patch notes, up to 2000 characters: what changed, for players. Shown on the game page and, for a major update, in the notification.

platform.description: Omit to keep the current setting. web: plays in the browser. desktop_app: native build only; upload from Manage → Desktop builds. Forces mobile false. Never ship a web page telling players to download the app.

screenshots.description: Optional: new screenshots, as paths inside the new build. Omit to keep the current ones.

slippi_online.description: A Melee build with Slippi netcode and Slippi online menus: true lets the desktop app offer each player, once, to lend this game their own Slippi sign-in (read-only); false turns it off. The same switch as Slippi online in Manage → Features. Omit to keep the current setting. The desktop app offers the sign-in on staging only for now.

slug.description: The game's slug: the last part of its URL, https://yougame.co/g/<slug>.

thumbnail.description: Optional: a new thumbnail, as a path inside the new build (16:9 PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF under 8 MB). Omit to keep the current one.

uploadId.description: The new build, from the upload reply (32 hex characters).

upstream.description: For a remix whose build was merged by hand after sync_remix reported conflicts: the original's build id the merge took (origin.upload_id in that reply), recorded as the remix's new base.

video.description: Optional: a new preview video, as an MP4/WebM path inside the new build (under 100 MB). Omit to keep the current one.

whole_game_lobby.description: true when online play is a single lobby that starts the whole game together; false when players pick among several lobby or mode types inside the game (no Play together button on its page). Omit if unsure; null clears the setting.

name: update_game
